claim_text: In an exploratory 50-example Amharic mT5 steering sweep, chrF reference overlap peaked at 0.4292 at strength 3.0, while outputs were non-empty and unique at every tested strength.
metric: chrF reference overlap; copy; emptiness; output diversity; edit similarity
selection_protocol: Five nonzero strengths {0.5,1.0,2.0,3.0,5.0}; no strength-0 baseline.
limitation: Steering vector and strength sweep use test data; no zero-strength paired baseline, no independent toxicity outcome, no confidence intervals, and no cross-seed replication.
